user.title: TeamSpeak 6 server
user.description: Connect to the WebQuery (HTTP query) of your TeamSpeak 6 server. Create a read-only key via the SSH query with `apikeyadd scope=read lifetime=0`.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the TeamSpeak server.
data_description.api_key: A key with scope read is enough.

reauth_confirm.title: New API key
reauth_confirm.description: The TeamSpeak server rejected the API key. Enter a new one.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the WebQuery. Is it enabled and is the port correct?

data_description.scan_interval: How often the client list is polled. 10–30 s is a good range.
data_description.rejoin_grace: A user who comes back within this time is flagged with rejoin: true in the join event, so automations can skip short reconnects.
